svg.text: Lot 10 m × 20 m = 200 m² · front setback 4 m · 3 m floor-to-floor
REAR WALL ON THE REAR LOT LINE
LOT A (west side of the street) · scale 1:200 · isometric: plan axes at 30° to the horizontal, all lengths measured true along the axes
Area of Floor(s) × Number of Floor(s)
Lot 10 m × 20 m = 200 m² · front setback 4 m · rear yard 0 m · side yard 1.25 m
Task: 4 floors that maximize the built area, then the
smallest footprint that still gives that area.
Max footprint = 70% × 200 m² = 140 m² → GFA 4 × 140 = 560 m².
Only the footprint AREA is fixed (140 m²); its shape is a choice.
Depth: all 16 m behind the 4 m setback (min back setback 0 m).
Width: 140 ÷ 16 = 8.75 m → 1.25 m side yard (min side setback 0).
Check: depth 16 m ≤ 16 m available · width 8.75 m ≤ 10 m
